title: security: RBAC v2 - enforce KMS region residency + audit logging for data-residency pinning
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: customers in regulated industries require strict KMS residency guarantees combined with RBAC controls and tamper-evident audit logs. This PR enforces KMS region residency at policy evaluation time, adds audit events for KMS region pinning decisions, and provides a migration path for existing keys. Key points: 1) Add kms_residency constraint to RBAC v2 policy schema and evaluator to deny or audit requests that attempt cross-region key usage; 2) Emit structured audit events (kms_region_pin.*) with stable fields for downstream compliance pipelines; 3) Add a feature flag (rbac.v2.kms_residency.enforce) and a canary rollout plan (audit-only -> enforce) to minimize disruption; 4) Provide a migration script to mark existing deployments and backfill audit records for the last 90 days; 5) Update docs and add integration tests. Checklist: - [x] Add policy enforcement hooks in role evaluator - [x] Structured audit events and retention note - [x] Backfill/migration script + dry-run option - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Docs + release notes - [x] Helm chart toggle for private deployments Compatibility: the change defaults to audit-only. Customers with strict enforcement can enable the flag via console/helm. Rollout: start with internal canary, roll to dedicated customers after 48h of no regressions. Linear/Jira: ENG-2384, SEC-112. Breaking change: none by default (audit-only); enabling enforcement may reject previously permitted requests if keys are incorrectly tagged. See docs/rbac/kms-region-residency.md for upgrade guidance.

release_notes: Enforced optional KMS region residency checks in RBAC v2 (audit-only by default). Added structured audit events for KMS region pinning and a migration/backfill script. Feature is controlled by rbac.v2.kms_residency.enforce (helm/console toggle). See docs/rbac/kms-region-residency.md for upgrade steps and mitigation guidance.
